helpWaiting.title: About Waiting
helpWaiting.overview: Waiting contains public-site visitor conversations that are ready for a human but have not yet been taken by you.

sections.title: Handle the queue
items: Peek to read a conversation without joining it.
Join to take ownership and move the conversation to Mine.
Release a conversation back to the bot or close it when appropriate.

sections.title: Bot and handoff
items: Public AI chat settings on Company control the visitor greeting, bot behaviour, identification, and human handoff.

helpMine.title: About Mine
helpMine.overview: Mine contains public website conversations that you have joined. Waiting is the queue of conversations you have not taken.

sections.title: Work your conversations
items: Continue the visitor thread from this list.
Release the conversation to the bot when human handling is no longer needed, or close it when finished.
